reviewNotes: Jodi's complete eight-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English, preserving her clinic, aerobics and Night Market contexts with every dialogue control exact.

spring_11.003.source: Vincent was very brave at the doctor's today. I'm proud of him.
spring_11.003.translation: Vincent a fost foarte curajos la doctor astăzi. Sunt mândră de el.

winter_17.000.source: It must be so thrilling to travel the world like they do... *sigh*...
winter_17.000.translation: Trebuie să fie atât de palpitant să călătorești prin lume ca ei... *suspină*...

spring_11.001.source: Be brave, Vincent. Think of your father.
spring_11.001.translation: Fii curajos, Vincent. Gândește-te la tatăl tău.

Tue.000.source: Ohhh... My arms feel like gelatin... $s
Tue.000.translation: Ohhh... Simt că brațele-mi sunt de gelatină... $s

spring_18.000.source: Hey! You can't just barge into a private appointment!$u
spring_18.000.translation: Hei! Nu poți da buzna la o consultație privată!$u

spring_11.002.source: Doctor Harvey? I'm worried about Vincent's height. Isn't he a little short for his age?
spring_11.002.translation: Doctore Harvey? Mă îngrijorează înălțimea lui Vincent. Nu este cam scund pentru vârsta lui?

spring_11.000.source: Vincent hates going to the doctor more than anything, but he'll just have to deal with it.
spring_11.000.translation: Vincent urăște mai mult decât orice să meargă la doctor, dar va trebui să se împace cu asta.
